# nanoid

A tiny, secure, URL-friendly unique string ID generator. Version 2.1.11.

## Usage

The package exports one function. Call it to get a 21-character id:

```js
const nanoid = require('nanoid')
model.id = nanoid() //=> "Uakgb_J5m9g-0JDMbcJqL"
```

Pass a number to change the length: `nanoid(10)`.
